name: QR_Rule_07: Security Log Cleared or Audit Policy Tampering
description: Detects clearing of Windows Security or System logs and changes to audit policy.
gpo_policy: Security and audit-policy changes must be logged and monitored.
expression: SELECT username, "Event ID", "Computer" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('1102','104','4719') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: Event ID is any of 1102, 104, or 4719. Response: Dispatch New Event and create a high-magnitude Offense indexed by Username.
